## Volcano plots

Volcano plots are interactive. Hover over the points to get information.

```{r}
#| label: res-volcano-plots
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
purrr::walk(seq_along(df_limma), function(i) {
  
  temp <- df_limma[[i]] %>%
    left_join(dplyr::select(raw$protein, Index, Gene),
              by = c("Protein.IDs" = "Index"))
  
  pval_col <- if (nrow(temp[which(temp$adj.P.Val < 0.05), ]) > 0) "adj.P.Val" else "P.Value"
  
  contrast_name <- comp_labels[names(df_limma)[i]]
  
  p <- make_volcano_plotly(temp, pval_col, "Gene", title = contrast_name)
  
  out <- knitr::knit_child(
    text  = c("```{r}", "#| echo: false", "#| warning: false", "p", "```"),
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  cat(out, sep = "\n")
})
```
